title: Battle of Cusco
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Cusco", at revision 1370109425, opens: "The Battle of Cusco was fought in November 1533 between the Spanish Conquistadors and forces of the Incas." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1612814, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1533 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
